title: What OpsAtlas is
text: OpsAtlas is a local-first governed organisational knowledge and operating-intelligence platform. It combines approved document retrieval with structured knowledge to provide cited answers, process intelligence, governance workflows and analytics.

title: Source approval and trust
text: OpsAtlas registers and ingests documents for review. Its document retrieval uses approved sources. A language model is not treated as the source of organisational truth. Human review remains necessary; source approval is not a guarantee that every statement is correct.

title: How answers use evidence
text: OpsAtlas combines document retrieval with ontology-assisted investigation. Document evidence supplies narrative context, while structured objects and relationships support relational questions. Answers can cite evidence or refuse unsupported questions; this is not a guarantee of perfect answers.

title: Process intelligence and activity views
text: OpsAtlas includes a Process Registry, process diagrams and Enterprise Activity Model views. These cover activities, accountability, risk, relationships and digital systems using governed source evidence.

title: Local operation and optional external rendering
text: Core OpsAtlas knowledge processing and model inference run locally. The optional Digital SME uses Anam as a managed avatar and speech-rendering layer. Local core processing should not be described as a guarantee that every optional integration operates offline.

title: Prototype access boundaries
text: The current OpsAtlas core is a proof of concept with single-operator authentication. It does not establish enterprise multi-user roles or per-source access controls. Production readiness and customer-specific security requirements need separate assessment.

title: Tiberius voice companion
text: Tiberius, or Tibi, is the experimental local voice companion. This sales workspace supports explicit conversation with product evidence. Background wake-name listening, multi-speaker sales meetings and automatic interview-to-approved-knowledge publication are not delivered in this iteration.

title: Commercial claims requiring owner input
text: This starting knowledge base does not establish pricing, guaranteed savings, certifications, customer references, service commitments or future release dates. Those details need explicit owner evidence and approval before they can be represented to customers.
